name: Sunstone Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunstone Development Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of prebaked carbon anodes for the aluminum industry in China and internationally. The company also provides aluminum anode products, battery anode material, and film capacitor series. It is also involved in the import of petroleum coke, as well as export of prebaked anodes. In addition, the company offers low-carbon services. Sunstone Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Linyi, China.
